description: This file defines a React component named 'ContactAside' which displays detailed contact information, including personal info, background, tags, and tasks, in a sidebar or aside panel in a CRM application.

methods.name: ContactAside
methods.description: A React functional component that renders contact information, including personal info, background, tags, and tasks, with options to view or edit the contact.

methods.name: PersonalInfoRow
methods.description: A helper React component that renders a row with an icon, primary info, and optionally the type, used within the ContactAside component.
